authority: New cross-business contracts distilled from shipped source; not original source and not runtime validation

rules.observed: Current native primary-tab reselection callback performs no action.
rules.implement: Keep the current page/state unless the new product explicitly chooses a different behavior.

rules.observed: Health detail navigation carries source item, date and device context.
rules.implement: Carry itemId/date/sourcePage through detail navigation; preserve context on return.

rules.observed: Health onVisible triggers non-manual sync; pull-to-refresh triggers manual sync.
rules.implement: Separate passive refresh from explicit refresh and show user-initiated progress without blanking previous content by default.
rules.scope: First sentence is code evidence; content-preservation policy is an adaptation.

rules.observed: Region next action is disabled without valid CountryInfo.
rules.implement: Derive submit.enabled from validated input and pending state; do not navigate on invalid submission.

rules.observed: allowClickWhenDisabled may retain ACTION_UP performClick despite disabled appearance.
rules.implement: Model disabled visual state and permitted explanation action separately; never silently execute the restricted operation.

rules.observed: Some device permission reminders have a non-forced 48-hour cooldown; forced user actions can bypass the reminder throttle.
rules.implement: Use an explicit configurable reminder policy. Do not impose this device-specific 48-hour value on unrelated permissions.

rules.observed: Share checks required artwork; missing asset shows download progress, success continues and failure gives short feedback.
rules.implement: Represent prerequisite preparation as idle/preparing/ready/error, with progress and recovery while retaining the user's destination.

rules.observed: RN top tabs ignore clicks while the pager is not idle.
rules.implement: Prevent overlapping transitions; release the guard when the pager reports idle.

rules.observed: RN settings row click uses a 300ms leading-only throttle.
rules.implement: Preserve a leading-only action guard for the matching component; do not turn 300ms into a universal latency for every control.

rules.observed: Privacy basic mode, logged-out state, no-device state and simple visual theme are distinct source conditions.
rules.implement: Keep mode/auth/content/visual-preference state independent. Avoid one boolean that hides all account and device content.
